model.description: Singular AI LLM model shared among all international.radio modules. Memory footprint capped at 512 MB. If exceeded, model is offloaded and modules fall back to heuristic keyword routing.

scouting.description: Each module scouts the internet daily using its own XML source list. Findings are written as college-readable paragraph documents in the module's source folder. Files grow up to 200 MB before the training thread consumes them.
